title: "The Making of a Movement: Sovereign Citizens and Their Historical Foundations"
summary: History of the movement's founder William Potter Gale, his Christian Identity mentor Wesley Swift, and the Posse Comitatus.

assertions.quote: In the 1970s, he helped found the Posi Cometus, an anti-government extremist group which spawned the southern citizen movement.
William Pgaleail was an anti-government activist and adherent of the racist Christian identity movement.

verdicts.note: Gale was a Christian Identity minister under Wesley Swift; historians link the Posse's founding ideas to that movement.
US OPCA ideas are said to have incubated in Militia, Aryan Nations and Christian Identity communities, but founders are not identified and Canadian strands had other origins.
The review says Posse Comitatus, the first root of the movement, was a radical right-wing Christian Identity sect tied to white supremacist Christian Identity.
